verses.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O YHWH, from the evil man; from the man of violence guard me—

segments.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O YHWH, from the evil man; from the man of violence guard me—

verses.text: those who devise evil in the heart, [and] all the day they stir up wars.

segments.text: those who devise evil in the heart, [and] all the day they stir up wars.

verses.text: They sharpen their tongues like a snake; the venom of a viper [is] under their lips. Selah

segments.text: They sharpen their tongues like a snake; the venom of a viper [is] under their lips. Selah

verses.text: keep me, O YHWH, from the hands of the wicked, from the man of violence guard me—those who have devised to push down my steps.

segments.text: keep me, O YHWH, from the hands of the wicked, from the man of violence guard me—those who have devised to push down my steps.

verses.text: The prideful ones have hidden a snare for me, and ropes they have spread [as] a net by the side of the path; lures they have set for me. Selah

segments.text: The prideful ones have hidden a snare for me, and ropes they have spread [as] a net by the side of the path; lures they have set for me. Selah

verses.text: I said, “O YHWH, You [are] my God;” give ear to, O YHWH, the voice of my supplications!

segments.text: I said, “O YHWH, You [are] my God;” give ear to, O YHWH, the voice of my supplications!

verses.text: YHWH [my] Lord, the strength of my salvation, You have covered my head on the day of armor.

segments.text: YHWH [my] Lord, the strength of my salvation, You have covered my head on the day of armor.

verses.text: Do not grant, O YHWH, the desires of the wicked; do not promote his wicked device; [lest] they be exalted! Selah

segments.text: Do not grant, O YHWH, the desires of the wicked; do not promote his wicked device; [lest] they be exalted! Selah

verses.text: the poison of those surrounding me, the trouble of their lips, let it cover them!

segments.text: the poison of those surrounding me, the trouble of their lips, let it cover them!

verses.text: Let burning coals fall upon them; let them be cast into the fire, into deep pits, never to rise up again!

segments.text: Let burning coals fall upon them; let them be cast into the fire, into deep pits, never to rise up again!

verses.text: A man of tongues, do not let him be established in the earth; a man of violence, may evil hunt him to overflowing!

segments.text: A man of tongues, do not let him be established in the earth; a man of violence, may evil hunt him to overflowing!

verses.text: I know that YHWH upholds justice for the poor, [and] judgment for the needy.

segments.text: I know that YHWH upholds justice for the poor, [and] judgment for the needy.

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will give praise to Your name; the upright will dwell with Your face.

segments.text: Indeed, the righteous will give praise to Your name; the upright will dwell with Your face.
